_comment: Post-election mode. From post_election_from (America/Chicago date) the routine runs scripts/results.py and writes election updates instead of pre-election briefs. Pre-election ratings are frozen at the last raw snapshot before that date.

uncalled_and_counting: 2026 midterm races too close to call
uncalled House races 2026 ballots still being counted
who_voted: 2026 midterm turnout voter file analysis who voted
2026 midterm new voters young voters turnout analysis

courtlistener._comment: scripts/courts.py. Token comes from a network secret for www.courtlistener.com on the cloud environment (preferred) or the environment variable named in token_env. Free tier: 5/min, 50/hr, 125/day; each run uses at most max_requests_per_run.
docket_queries: election AND (ballot OR ballots OR recount OR certification OR canvass)
"Department of Justice" AND election AND ballots
"Secretary of State" AND election AND (ballots OR certification)
opinion_queries: election AND (ballot OR ballots OR recount OR certification)
